title: Evaluation modulo a positive integer
statement: Let $k$ be a positive natural number, let $a$ assign a natural number to each input index, and let $gs$ be a finite list of algebraic gates. For every initial list $vs$ of natural numbers whose entries are all less than $k$, mapping the list produced by evaluating $gs$ modulo $k$ from $vs$ into $\mathbb Z/k\mathbb Z$ gives the same list as evaluating the gates in that ring from the mapped initial list; moreover, every entry of the natural-number evaluation list is less than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: a map from input indices to natural numbers
a finite list of algebraic gates
every entry of $vs$ is less than $k$
